snippet.title: Encryption - World Premiere Reveal | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Wildfires have emptied Matera, one of the oldest cities in Italy. You search for your missing daughter, while shadow entities hunt you by sound: every step through water, every lever thrown, tells them where you are. Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure by Digital Lighthouse Games. Coming to PC in 2027.
